doc: What the setup step reads from the player's Space Marine 2 install, one row per kind of asset per weapon. Sounds are real from milestone 2; textures are decoded to PNG; models and numbers are a later upgrade (milestone 5) - the first build uses Dark Souls III's own weapon models and numbers and says so.

weapon_name.doc: SM2's own name for the weapon

pak_pattern.doc: which pak entries hold it (name pattern)

format.doc: container/codec as seen in the scan

converter.doc: how it becomes something DS3 can use

output.doc: where the converted result goes, under {data}/assets

rows.format: Saber 1SER binary classes (changes with SM2 patches)
rows.converter: later upgrade: parse the mesh and write a Dark Souls III weapon model; not part of the first build

rows.format: res_desc_pct descriptor + raw block-compressed mip data (BC7, BC5 for normal maps)
rows.converter: crates/sm2 texture loader (bcdec_rs) writes PNG previews; not applied to Dark Souls III weapons in the first build

rows.pak_pattern: client_pc/root/paks/client/**: sounds/desktop/wpn.bnk (events) and sounds/desktop/wpn.zip (<media id>.wem, a stored zip inside a pak)
rows.format: Wwise bank v150 (BKHD+HIRC, no embedded media) + Wwise Vorbis .wem (format tag 0xFFFF, stripped setup, external aoTuV codebooks)
rows.converter: ashenmarine-setup prepare: event -> action -> container walk, rebuild standard Vorbis packets (ww2ogg algorithm, BSD-3), decode with lewton, mix layers into takes

rows.format: Saber .cls text: key = { __type = "..." } (effects and sound names; no damage numbers found so far)
rows.converter: later upgrade: read the numbers the .cls files hold, if any, and map them onto the Dark Souls III weapon row
